name: Lyo.Ledger
tagline: Double-entry ledger contracts: chart of accounts, journals, post/void, and client AR balance.
description: Double-entry books used by Billing. `ILedgerStore` posts balanced journals and voids by writing a reversing journal. Posted rows are immutable. `GetClientArBalance` reads posted AR lines (account 1100) and excludes reversing journals, not a column on the client.
features: Seeded CoA codes on `LedgerAccountCodes`: 1000 Cash, 1100 AR, 2200 Tax payable, 4000 Revenue.
`PostJournalAsync` requires debit total = credit total, then freezes the journal.
`VoidJournalAsync` posts a reversing journal. Posted rows are never deleted.

examples.title: Post a balanced journal
